summary: Accepted reference sheet titled 'ADVENTURES OF PATCH | PROPS ANTI-PATTERNS SHEET (v1)' that catalogs prop drift risks for the Adventures of Patch visual style. The sheet is divided into a top banner with purpose, core rules, and check-before-approval prompts, a central field of illustrated anti-pattern cards, and a footer that reads 'ONE WORLD. ONE STYLE. KEEP IT CLEAR, FRIENDLY, AND ADVENTURES OF PATCH.' with a date stamp.

composition: Landscape reference-sheet layout with a cream field, dark framing, and structured rule banners.
Top banner carries the title 'ADVENTURES OF PATCH | PROPS ANTI-PATTERNS SHEET (v1)' and three labelled columns: 'PURPOSE', 'CORE RULES', and 'CHECK BEFORE APPROVAL'.
Central area presents a grid of illustrated anti-pattern cards, each with a caption describing a prop drift risk.
Bottom banner shows the footer text and a row of small icon/status badges plus a date stamp.
core_rules: Respect physical logic, contact, and construction.
Keep designs simple and consistent with the world and story-relevant style.
Use the anti-patterns to keep props believable, consistent, and supportive of the story and world.
When in doubt, remove, simplify, or revise.
check_before_approval_prompts: Is it simple, friendly, and consistent?
Is it readable at a glance?
Is the style consistent and on-palette?
Does it look maintained and purposefully placed?
anti_pattern_cards: Extra shelf items not part of the scene
footer: Footer reads 'ONE WORLD. ONE STYLE. KEEP IT CLEAR, FRIENDLY, AND ADVENTURES OF PATCH.'
A date stamp and small status badges appear at the right of the footer.

positive_constraints: Use this sheet as the accepted props anti-patterns / drift-risks reference for Adventures of Patch.
Keep props physically believable, simple, and consistent with the world and story.
Use the core rules and check-before-approval prompts as a QA checklist for props and set dressing.
Preserve the reference-sheet layout and the anti-pattern grid when reproducing or referencing the sheet.
Maintain the Adventures of Patch palette and friendly illustrative style for props.
Remove, simplify, or revise props that match the listed anti-patterns.
negative_constraints: Do not treat this sheet as final approval for every prop design; inspect image pixels for exact wording.
Do not add new anti-patterns or core rules beyond those shown on the sheet.
Do not infer that the listed anti-patterns are absolute bans; they are drift risks to check against.
Do not reproduce small text, labels, or icon captions exactly without pixel-level verification.
Do not use this sheet to authorize derivative prop reference images.

best_for: Prop QA and anti-pattern review in Adventures of Patch scenes.
Prompt constraints for prop generation and set dressing.
Style continuity checks for props and environmental objects.
Teaching and identifying common prop drift risks.
not_sufficient_for: Final acceptance of generated props without image QA.
Exact transcription of small labels, badges, or icon captions.
